prompt: The block picker UI in src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/BlockPicker.client.luau has gotten really noisy with comments. Please tidy them up so only the useful ones are left.
rubric: Changes only comments: every line of code is the same as before; the only edits are to comment text and the blank lines that deleted comments leave behind. No new files.

Keeps the comments that carry information the code can't show, trimmed where they ran long: that PlacementController reads the SelectedBlock attribute (so the name must stay in sync), why Activated is used instead of MouseButton1Click (touch and gamepad), why gameProcessed input is skipped (typing in a TextBox such as chat), and the gamepad TODO.
Keeps tool directives exactly as they were: --!strict and --# selene: allow(mixed_table) at the top.

Removes narration that restates the code: 'Get services', 'Import Vide', per-property comments such as 'Rounded corners' or 'don't reset on spawn', block-end markers such as 'end -- for' and 'end) -- InputBegan', and the doc comment that only lists parameter names and types.
Removes or corrects comments that are wrong: 'Default selection is Brick' (the code selects Grass), and the commented-out Roact lines.
Removes change history and dangling references: the v2 and v2.1 changelog, 'per code review', and 'per the UI spec, section 2.3'.
Removes the section banner inside the TextButton's property table, and any header comment that survives is short and describes what the script does now.
